Alice — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP and evaluation plan (KiteHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level summary below; full test matrix is in the attachment.

Summary of proposed evaluation plan (high level):
- Objective: Validate latency, TTFT, throughput and multi-region failover under production-like load to enable procurement sign-off.
- Test windows: staged runs 7/6-7/9 (US), 7/10-7/12 (EU), 7/13-7/15 (APAC). Final cross-region failover run 7/15.
- Metrics to capture: p50/p90/p99 latency (token-level), TTFT (time to first token), tokens/sec steady-state, max sustainable concurrent sessions, error rates, cold-start behaviour.
- Concurrency targets: 50, 200, 1k concurrent sessions; ramp profiles included.
- Acceptance thresholds (proposed): p90 < 250ms US/EU, p90 < 350ms APAC; TTFT < 150ms p50; error rate < 0.5% sustained; graceful failover < 5s for routing convergence.
- Failover playbook: primary region + automated cross-region routing with 2s probing and 3s failover hold; fallback to a quantized lower-cost model variant when capacity is constrained.

Attachments include: the MAP with milestone dates, test matrix, shell scripts for the load harness, and the result CSV template. We will run tests from Redwood-managed agents in each region (we'll provide endpoints).

Immediate asks for KiteHealth:
1) Confirm the acceptance thresholds above or propose changes.
2) Provide staging account keys and the test endpoints you want us to hit (we'll use an isolated token to avoid production data).
3) Confirm test windows or propose alternatives.

Next steps: once we get credentials, Marcus will run the harness and deliver raw results; Laura will author the MAP milestone tracker for signatures. I propose a final sync on 7/16 to review results; target procurement sign-off 7/20–7/22.

Thanks,
Priyom Das

Subject: RE: Initial request: regional perf testing + MAP for Q3 close — summary & next steps

Alice — quick consolidated delivery from our runs (attached raw CSV: regional-results-20260715.csv). Short summary and recommended go/no-go below.

Summary results (cross-region, aggregated):
- US (run 07/06): p50=62ms, p90=180ms, p99=310ms; TTFT p50=120ms; sustained tokens/sec (steady-state) = 7.1k; concurrency target reached: 1k sessions with error rate 0.28%.
- EU (run 07/11): p50=75ms, p90=205ms, p99=390ms; TTFT p50=135ms; tokens/sec = 6.4k; concurrency target reached: 1k sessions, error rate 0.4%.
- APAC (run 07/14): p50=140ms, p90=320ms, p99=620ms; TTFT p50=190ms; tokens/sec = 4.2k; concurrency target reached: 200 sessions stable; 1k session attempts hit sustained error rate 1.8% and backend throttling.

Failover & routing behaviour (cross-region test 07/15):
- Simulated network partition for EU region (30s): automated routing converged in 3.2s on average with the configured 2s probe + 3s hold; failover path used US variant for ~80% of requests and APAC for 20% depending on origination.
- Cold-cache ramp after failover showed TTFT spike up to 650ms for first 10s before steadying.
- When APAC is primary and saturated, routing correctly shifted to a quantized model variant with ~15% token increase in latency but preserved request success rates.

Interpretation & recommended actions:
- Go (with suggested config): US & EU meet acceptance thresholds as-is. APAC requires either increased capacity or aggressive quantized model routing for 1k concurrency goals.
- Recommended configuration changes for APAC: raise target instance count in APAC pool by +30% or enable automatic quantized fallback earlier (at 200 concurrent sessions) to keep p90 < 350ms.
- Suggested contract appendix language: map milestone for perf validation complete; Redwood to deliver final annotated PDF and raw CSVs; KiteHealth to confirm go/no-go by 7/20.

Next steps:
1) We will upload the aggregated PDF + raw CSVs to the Drive link and share access by EOD tonight.
2) Laura will prepare the MAP milestone tracker for signatures (deadline: 07/20 for go/no-go).
3) Marcus to open a short RFC to increase APAC capacity if KiteHealth elects to pursue 1k concurrency in APAC (estimate: +3 nodes, cost delta included in appendix).

If KiteHealth confirms go with the above APAC mitigations, we can proceed to contract signature in the 07/20–07/22 window.

Thanks all — ping with any questions.
